entities.name: Géza Tuli
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Géza Titusz Tuli was a Hungarian gymnast who competed in the 1912 Summer Olympics. He was part of the Hungarian team, which won the silver medal in the gymnastics men's team, European system event in 1912.
